what_to_detect: The enchanted-creature static of a bestowed Aura on the battlefield (a token copy of a bestowed spell included) contributes to the creature it is attached to.
near_miss: A bestow card cast normally is a creature and its static contributes nothing.

what_to_detect: A bestowed Aura whose enchanted creature left the battlefield in the record stays on the battlefield as an enchantment creature instead of going to the graveyard.
near_miss: An ordinary Aura whose host left goes to the graveyard (aura_illegal).
record_fields: resolution effect-half zone_change of the host
snapshot Aura entity staying on battlefield

what_to_detect: A bestowed Aura that became attached illegally is unattached and a creature: its enchanted-creature static applies and contributes nothing.
near_miss: A bestowed Aura attached legally contributes to its creature.

what_to_detect: A bestowed Aura that phased in unattached is a creature: its enchanted-creature static contributes nothing.
near_miss: A bestowed Aura attached to a creature contributes to it.
